services.name: Dueling Zipline
services.desc: Soar from tree to tree at Anakeesta’s Dueling Zipline Adventure in Gatlinburg, Tennessee! Enjoy beautiful views, while zipping side by side with your family and friends, as you zip line in the Smoky Mountains. Experience our three zip excursion and multiple rappels for a thrill that will leave you begging for more. Pick a date and sign your waiver! Our guides are waiting to take you on an experience you will never forget! Reservations are not required, but are strongly encouraged as tours sell out quickly.
